mapper.select: SELECT A.RC_CODE, A.RC_RFILE_NO, A.RC_RITEM_NO, A.BND_TTL, A.JEMOK, A.ALL_ORG_NM, SUBSTRING_INDEX(A.ALL_ORG_NM, ' ', 1) AS DEPT_NM, A.PRODREGDATE, B.PRODYEAR FROM CN_RITEM A JOIN ( SELECT RC_RFILE_NO, PRODYEAR FROM CN_ELEC_DOC WHERE TRANSFERYEAR = #{transferYear} AND PRODYEAR = #{prodYear} AND RC_RFILE_NO = #{rcRfileNo} GROUP BY RC_RFILE_NO, PRODYEAR ) B ON A.RC_RFILE_NO = B.RC_RFILE_NO WHERE A.RC_RFILE_NO = #{rcRfileNo} ORDER BY A.RC_RFILE_NO, A.RC_RITEM_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE CN_RITEM SET POLICY_CD = #{result.itemCd}, POLICY_NM = #{result.policy}, LLM_POLICY_STATUS = 'PASS', LLM_POLICY_ERR_MSG = NULL, LLM_POLICY_UPDT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE RC_RFILE_NO = #{target.rcRfileNo}
